h1: Handoff to your team, with the full history attached
overview: Customers hate repeating themselves. We set up the moment when your chat or email helper steps aside and a person takes over. The agent receives the whole conversation, a short summary, the customer name, order and the reason for the handoff. You decide which situations trigger it, such as anger, refunds or a direct request for a human, and who gets notified when it happens.

faq: Where will my team receive the handoff?
In your help desk, shared inbox or chat tool such as Slack, Teams, Zendesk or Gorgias. We use what your staff already open and set up the alert there.
The customer gets a clear message with your opening hours and a promise of reply time that you set. The case waits in the queue with everything attached.
Which cases should always go to a person?
We suggest a starting list: refund disputes, angry messages, legal or safety topics and VIP customers. You can edit the list, and we explain the tradeoffs.
Do I need a live chat product already?
You need somewhere for agents to reply. If you have none, we recommend a low cost option and set it up, with the tool subscription billed to you.
